in_marathi.name: Gauahar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Cow, Gau; Protector, Har
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gauahar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gauahar is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Gau’ meaning cow and ‘Har’ meaning protector. The name is thus symbolic of one who protects and nurtures like a mother cow. In Hindu mythology, Gauahar is an epithet of Goddess Kamadhenu, the divine bovine, who is the source of all nourishment and prosperity.
